currentParagraphText: “I perhaps overstepped,” the True Ancestor acknowledged her mistake. Meanwhile, Fairleigh was merely looking at them while clearly trying to handle the pressure from being in the presence of a powerful god. He wasn’t looking that good. Contrarily, the Sword Saint had already adapted to her aura, and while he could certainly still feel her presence, it was quite manageable.
